runtime_behavior: An exact canonical spawn ID selects one materialized world-owned spawn slot.
Living members atomically enter the established death-to-respawn-wait boundary.
Dead, blocked, or waiting members have stale execution and block metadata cleared before deterministic immediate re-admission.
Disabled slots remain respawn-suppressed and are not silently re-enabled.
The reset request, reason, optional world tick, and affected instance IDs are persisted or returned for audit.
safe_fallback: Unknown spawn IDs return no result. This boundary does not claim to reproduce native soft-reset, hard-reset, chance, or population algorithms.
runtime_impact: Adds an executable administrative lifecycle reset using existing spawn ownership and admission rules.
world_state_impact: NPC lifecycle state and respawn scheduling are updated atomically under the world lock.

provenance.record_ids: all canonical materialized spawn IDs selected at runtime
